results.title: High Efficiency Transformation Protocol using NEB 10-beta Competent E. coli (C3019H)

protocols.name: Thaw competent cells
protocols.description: Thaw a tube of NEB 10-beta Competent E. coli cells on ice for 10 minutes.

protocols.name: Add plasmid DNA
protocols.description: Add 1-5 µl containing 1 pg-100 ng of plasmid DNA to the cell mixture.

protocols.name: Mix cells and DNA
protocols.description: Carefully flick the tube 4-5 times to mix cells and DNA. Do not vortex.

protocols.name: Incubation on ice
protocols.description: Place the mixture on ice for 30 minutes. Do not mix.

protocols.name: Heat shock
protocols.description: Heat shock at exactly 42°C for exactly 30 seconds. Do not mix.

protocols.name: Post heat shock ice
protocols.description: Place on ice for 5 minutes. Do not mix.

protocols.name: Add outgrowth medium
protocols.description: Pipette 950 µl of room temperature NEB 10-beta/Stable Outgrowth Medium into the mixture.

protocols.name: Outgrowth incubation
protocols.description: Place at 37°C for 60 minutes, shaking vigorously (250 rpm) or rotating.

protocols.name: Warm selection plates
protocols.description: Warm selection plates to 37°C.

protocols.name: Mix cells thoroughly
protocols.description: Mix the cells thoroughly by flicking the tube and inverting.

protocols.name: Serial dilutions
protocols.description: Perform several 10-fold serial dilutions in NEB 10-beta/Stable Outgrowth Medium.

protocols.name: Spread dilutions
protocols.description: Spread 50-100 µl of each dilution onto a selection plate.

protocols.name: Incubate plates
protocols.description: Incubate overnight at 37°C.

results.title: "Isolating Specific Cell Subsets Directly from Whole Blood Without Columns or Magnets"

protocols.name: Temperature equilibration
protocols.description: Ensure blood sample, PBS + 2% FBS, density gradient medium, and centrifuge are at room temperature (15 - 25°C).

protocols.name: Add RosetteSep cocktail
protocols.description: Add RosetteSep™ cocktail to the sample and mix well.

protocols.name: Incubation
protocols.description: Incubate 20 minutes at room temperature.

protocols.name: Dilution
protocols.description: Dilute sample with an equal volume of PBS + 2% FBS and mix gently.

protocols.name: Density gradient layering
protocols.description: Layer the diluted sample on top of the density gradient medium using the recommended volumes (see note). Be careful to minimize mixing of the density gradient medium and the sample.

protocols.name: Centrifugation
protocols.description: Centrifuge at 1200 x g for 20 minutes at room temperature, with the brake off.

protocols.name: Cell collection
protocols.description: Remove the enriched cells from the density gradient medium:plasma interface.

protocols.name: Interface recovery
protocols.description: Sometimes it is difficult to see cells at the interface, especially when very rare cells are enriched. To maximize recovery in these instances, remove some of the density gradient medium along with the enriched cells.
outputs: Enriched cells with some density gradient medium

protocols.name: Wash 1
protocols.description: Wash enriched cells with PBS + 2% FBS, centrifuge at 300 x g for 10 min, with brake on low. Discard supernatant.
inputs: Enriched cells with some density gradient medium

protocols.name: RBC lysis (optional)
protocols.description: Residual red blood cells are removed from samples by ammonium chloride lysis to reduce interference with subsequent assays or with flow cytometric analysis. The lysis can be performed as part of either wash step.

protocols.name: Wash 2
protocols.description: Wash enriched cells with PBS + 2% FBS, centrifuge at 300 x g for 10 min, with brake on low. Discard supernatant.

protocols.name: RBC lysis (optional)
protocols.description: To remove residual RBCs, perform lysis with ammonium chloride as part of either wash step.

protocols.name: Use enriched cells
protocols.description: Use enriched cells as desired.
